subject: WAIC calculations for multistate capture-recapture models

messages.author: c4f557fbb8021162
messages.subject: WAIC calculations for multistate capture-recapture models
parts:
Hello all,

mostly out of curiosity, I have tried to calculate WAIC for a multistate mark-recapture model I have been working with. WAIC always calculations returned "NaN", irrespective of whether I used the wrapper function nimbleMCMC(..., WAIC = TRUE) or buildt the model stepwise (via nimbleModel(...) --> configureMCMC(...) --> buildMCMC(..., enableWAIC = TRUE) --> compileNimble(...) --> model$run() --> model$WAIC()).

Running the model uncompiled did not produce any helpful warning/error messages, so I tried it on some simple examples from BPA ("Bayesian Population Analysis using WinBUGS", Kery & Schaub 2011) and/or modified versions of them from the Nimble workshop in April 2018.
(All codes and example data - if required - are attached here).

In short, I found this:

1) Dipper example (BPA Ch.7), CJS formulation: WAIC calculations return a number.
2) Dipper example, reformulated as 2-state multistate CR model: WAIC calculations return a number.
3) Plover example (BPA Ch.9), 3-state multistate CR model: WAIC calculations return "NaN"
4) Orchid example (BPA Ch.9), 4-state multistate CR model: WAIC calculations return "NaN"

Based on this, it looks like WAIC calculations fail for multistate CR models with more than 2 states. Why would that happen? Is there a way to find out exactly at which step of WAIC calculations things go wrong?

Any help much appreciated.
Cheers,

Chloé
